source_evidence: Exact player 'Cirren you keep the documents. We will wait until the office closes then I will go back in'. Actual custody transfer, observed ordinary closure and successful lock check. Ordinary closing time, access lock and room furnishings newly adjudicated consistent with existing fixed site, not recovered historical fact; no secret meeting or guarantee of prepared agreement present. D326~18:12 at the broker's rented upper office above the counting shop ~200ft uphill from storehouse1, Orsaven. V alone just inside office, Cirren/Fenar keeping watch outside in public street, Mara Copper Hart with coach/four horses. Exact player 'Cirren you keep the documents. We will wait until the office closes then I will go back in' authorizes transfer of both originals to Cirren, ordinary discreet waiting until observed closing, and V's reentry by ordinary lock access (not additional theft, opening containers, further resource use or violence). Cirren willingly accepts physical custody of original lot27 invoice and Noldren Tavosk signed sealed acknowledgement, both secured in his satchel; no copies, alteration, Watch handoff or third-party disclosure. Party waits on public street; newly played ordinary closure fixed ~18:10, observes actual broker emerge, exchange ordinary words with shopkeeper and walk toward Exchange district; shopkeeper then closes/locks premises and leaves. No actual tail of broker, claim of destination arrival or proof of exhaustive vacancy. No scheduled meeting, unseen patrol, discovered theft or independent alert asserted. Active surveillance not a qualifying rest. Existing upper rented room 40x25ft, public stair and rear service stair per prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-setup.md @300789a66801d87700502e1499b9cfbb15ff72b4; rear service entrance gives access to existing service stair and office, ordinary lock DC15 fixed before dice. V uses owned proficient thieves' tools +8, genuine d20 face19 total27 succeeds; quiet entry via rear service access and stair to upper room; no additional lock, uncertain observer or automatic new contested check. Newly fixed ordinary room furnishing before any search: worktable, two chairs, low correspondence cabinet, small stack of folded commercial papers on table and ledger on shelf, shuttered windows, dim ambient evening light; no specific contents or prepared proposed250gp agreement asserted present, no active occupants observed in room. No trap or magic lock invented. V still wearing apron/cap; no document taken, opened, read or searched yet; no extra movement/exit chosen. Await V's inspection choice. Psychic Whispers active Cirren/Fenar until23:05, no Mara link. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi3/6 MP6/7 PastLife2/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers0/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots +1Shield no concentration; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia natural+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging mechanical greataxe unchanged. Purse2049gp8sp6cp, rations21/feed28, LR0/6; no spending. Exact Cirren-held invoice 'RIVERSIDE STOREHOUSE No. 2 — Received in full: 36 gp. One case fine imported lace. Lot 27, transferred from Storehouse No. 1. For the joint freight account: paid.' Exact Cirren-held acknowledgement 'Received fourteen gold pieces for information supplied concerning the forthcoming berth inspections. I shall continue to represent your interests in the matter of selective inspection exemptions.' Seal identified by broker as commercial petition delegate Noldren Tavosk, office Exchange district; D3206gp and D3238gp matching fee entries and broker reimbursement column left in warehouse accountant custody. Witnessed ferry/lighter transfer, receiver purse to landing official, freight sale; no proved involvement of other actors in Quenwood murders or enacted exemptions. Paymaster holds48gp pending lawful restitution, notification promised not verified sent. Quenwood life sentence upheld, assets frozen. Skiff rescued and Meret referral delivered, no business contract. Royal recommendation pending, Kestrel confidential copies complete original custody unchanged; separate frontier commission300+1300 contingent; western conditional recovery grant signed not deed, Coris300 pending optional800, magic orders balance520 target353. Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. V dice delegated.
